title: People-first sprint 1:1 prep — Lena \u2013 Jan 9 2027
content:
Context and purpose:
Quick prep notes for my 1:1 with Priya (IC1 -> IC2 growth track). Goal: focus on people signals this sprint, surface blockers, align on next growth steps and team support. Keep it short and tactical.

Top-of-mind signals (what I want to validate)
- Energy level: sounded a bit quieter in async last week. Is that burnout or just deep focus on the quantization spike?
- Ownership runway: shipped the KV cache micro-optimization but rolled back in staging due to perf regression on long sequences (JIRA-2891). How confident does Priya feel in leading the followup?
- Career momentum: Priya expressed curiosity about mentoring but hasn't run a regular onboarding pairing session yet. Opportunity to map to IC2 rubric.

Agenda (30 minutes)
1) Quick check-in (3-5m) — personal pulse, calendar sanity
2) Sprint debrief (8-10m) — what shipped, what regressed, root causes for the KV cache rollback, what we learn
3) Career & mentorship (8-10m) — interest in owning a recurring onboarding pair session + potential scope for leading a small tooling spike
4) Blockers & support requests (5m) — any infra/permissions/people bottlenecks I should unblock
5) Actions and next steps (3m)

Prep notes / prompts to ask
- "How are you feeling about the sprint overall? Any tasks that drained you or felt energizing?"
- "Walk me through the KV cache issue in your words — what's the smallest repro and what's our hypothesis?"
- "What would success look like for mentorship in the next 6 weeks? Who would you pair with?"
- "Is there anything you need from my side (advocacy, calendar buffers, hiring ask, infra access)?"

Things I want to share (one-liners)
- Recognition: noticed the data-driven approach you took on benchmarks — call that out (internally in sync and in engineering digest).
- Risk: rollout cadence for low-level infra changes is the team's largest source of flakiness; we need a short post-mortem with actionable guardrails.
- Offer: I can pair-review the follow-up PR with you and help prioritize the canary testing window next week.

Potential red flags to probe
- Repeated late nights on sequencing experiments (signal for too-wide scope or unclear acceptance criteria).
- Avoiding mentorship opportunities (might be confidence or time management).
- Over-indexing on micro-optimizations before full regression tests — needs process improvement.

Draft action items (I will confirm in meeting and capture owners + due dates)
- Priya: create a tiny repro case + benchmark harness for the KV cache regression by Jan 12. (owner: Priya; due: 2027-01-12)
- Me (Lena): schedule 60m pairing session next Tues to work the test harness + review the patch (owner: Lena; due: 2027-01-11)
- Priya: run 2 onboarding pairing sessions with new hire Sami in next 3 weeks and write short checklist (owner: Priya; due: 2027-01-31)
- Team: short post-mortem doc (2 pages max) and a one-line rollout checklist for infra patches (owner: eng-platform; due: 2027-01-20)

Notes-to-self during the call (short stubs)
- If Priya frames this as unclear acceptance criteria, ask for specific examples and propose adding a "perf-safety" gating step to PR template.
- If burnout signal, ask about time off and immediate load decreases (reassign or delay non-critical tasks).
- Mention potential for a small mentorship stipend/pulse if she consistently runs pairing sessions (follow-up with People Ops).

Follow-up plan after meeting
- Send a short recap in DM + add action items to Priya's JIRA epic; copy eng leads.
- Draft the 1-page post-mortem template and share for review in #eng-postmortems channel.
- Remind Priya about the pairing slot on my calendar and book a follow-up 1:1 in 3 weeks focused on mentorship outcomes.

Freeform scratch (brain dump)
- Could nudge Priya toward leading the small tools spike: 'onboarding-checklist-generator' — good coaching opportunity, scope = one script + 1 page doc.
- Consider rotating "canary owner" responsibility across the infra team to spread knowledge.
- Leave room in next sprint for a tech debt day to avoid burnout from continuous small regressions.

Unresolved questions to raise later
- Do we have capacity to increase canary test coverage for long sequences without impacting throughput? (Ask SRE).
- Is there appetite from People Ops for a micro-incentive for mentorship hours? (Maya).

Tone reminders to self
- Be direct but curious. Prioritize listening first. Keep it pragmatic. Celebrate small wins.

End of doc — capture final action items in meeting notes and close loop.
